In c. [[2 BBY]], a '''resistance''' was occured when a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], [[Chop'aa Notimo]] and [[Chop'aa Notimo's Mandalorians|his]] Mandalorians assaulted [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and engaged in battle against the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]], led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], Cloud City's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] liaison officer. 

This resistance was short-lived, as later Chop'aa was killed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]'s former secret [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice, [[Galen Marek]], when he was involved to finding the [[Corellian/Legends|corellian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], in case to founding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
